name: video_color_transfer
description: Grades a clip to match the palette of a reference image — use it when the target look exists as a still rather than as a named LUT. Picking from the LUT catalog or dialling values by hand → `video_color_grade`. Max 20s / 200 MB, up to 4K (3840x2160). Requires a paid plan. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation to grade. Max 20s, 200 MB, 4K (3840x2160).

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

referenceImageIdentifier.description: Completed owned image creation whose palette the clip should take.

strength.description: How far to push towards the reference, 0-1. Default 1.
